Features

  • Colossus Slayer

    Once per turn, your weapon attack deals an extra 1d8⁠⁠PhysicalDRS damage if the target is below its hit point maximum.

  • Draconic Ancestry: Copper (Acid)

    At Level 6: Acid spells deal more damage; gain Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

  • Elemental Affinity: Damage

    When you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you add your Charisma Modifier to the damage.

  • Escape the Horde

    Opportunity Attacks against you have  Disadvantage.

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Mage Breaker

    You have a history of battling spellcasters. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can cast  True Strike.

  • Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain

    You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness.  Difficult Terrain no longer slows you down.

  • Multiattack Defence

    When an enemy attacks you, they have a -4 penalty to additional Attack Rolls against you until the start of their next turn.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Steel Will

     Advantage on  Saving throws against being  Frightened.

  • Wasteland Wanderer: Poison

    You have spent endless days surviving fetid swamps. Gain resistance to ⁠Poison, taking only half damage from it.

Old Flake-Eyes is a dragonborn follower of the Stone Lord.

Involvement

Flake-Eyes can found in the middle of an argument with the Guild at the Western Beach in Rivington during Act Three.
